page.overview:
Who is Brake Boyd?

Brake Boyd is a minor character in Cars. He is a blue car that is a fan of the Piston Cup Racing Series.

Brake can be seen attending the tie-breaker race at the Los Angeles International Speedway. He, Coriander Widetrack, and M.A. Brake Drumm watch admiringly as Marco, Stu Bop, and another jet fly over them.
